title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
description: Around the world, strange events captured on camera are raising fears of impending doom; blackbirds fall dead from the sky and waters near the Dead Sea turn blood-red; Tony Harris and his team investigate the evidence and deliver their verdict.

title: M*A*S*H
description: To raise money to send his Korean houseboy to medical school, Hawkeye raffles off a weekend in Tokyo with a nurse.

title: M*A*S*H
description: Hawkeye and Trapper attempt to retrieve a supply of hydrocortisone stolen by black marketeers. Guest starring Jack Soo and Robert Ito.

title: Mountain Men
description: A new generation of mountain men takes on the Wild North, as Randy battles wolves threatening his cattle, Kie and Dave target destructive beavers, Broc experiments with a new way to lure bears, and Connor puts his next generation of sled dogs to the test.

title: Mountain Men
description: Broc hauls barrels of honey high into the trees in hopes of drawing bears out of hiding; Kie and Dave make use of every part of their beaver harvest; Connor takes his B-team of sled dogs into the wilderness, where one mistake threatens to derail the run; and Aron and Jen race to clear dangerous deadfall from their property without damaging their home or sparking another wildfire.

title: Big Timber

title: Ancient Aliens
description: In every corner of the world, archaeologists have found strange, elongated skulls; did our ancestors modify the shape of their skulls to resemble extraterrestrial visitors?; and might it even be possible that some of these skulls are of otherworldly origin?

title: Ancient Aliens
description: Oceania contains remote Pacific islands featuring massive stone structures and strange statuary; local legends describe otherworldly visitors, adding to the mystery of these ancient sites.

title: Ancient Aliens
description: High above the Giza Plateau stands Egypt's most mysterious ancient site: the Lost Pyramid of Abu Rawash; today, it lies in ruins, but some researchers believe these stone blocks hold profound secrets about an extraterrestrial civilization that existed in ancient Egypt long before our recorded history.

title: Ancient Aliens
description: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos explores ancient structures that defy conventional explanation; from the precisely cut stone blocks at Puma Punku to the temples of Malta and the megalithic city of Nan Madol, could these mysterious sites contain evidence of extraterrestrial contact in the distant past?

title: Ancient Aliens
description: For thousands of years, humankind has attempted to make contact with beings from beyond Earth; now, the search for extraterrestrial intelligence is ramping up, with new technologies allowing individuals to explore the universe.

title: Ancient Aliens
description: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos explores the series archives to investigate mysterious moments that just might contain an extraterrestrial connection; from a stone circle in Turkey that challenges the timeline of human history to gigantic stone spheres in Bosnia and Egypt's most unusual tombs, could these monuments provide proof of extraterrestrial visitation?

title: Ancient Aliens
description: Examining maritime folklore regarding aquatic entities and reviewing contemporary reports of unidentified aerial phenomena over oceanic regions and investigating whether deep-sea environments host undocumented anomalies.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description: Remember when hitting the road promised freedom, adventure... and a few risky surprises? From marathon cross-country races that pushed drivers to the limit, to flaming roadside smudge pots that lined the way after dark, to endless stretches of highway that lulled motorists into dangerous trances, America's love affair with the open road was full of unexpected twists and turns. These are the engineering feats and automotive innovations that transformed the journey.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description: Secrets of popes, rewritten laws and cities lost to the waves are divine discoveries that shake our beliefs and uncover mysteries.

title: History's Mystery Files
description: Across the globe, certain locations seem to resist explanation; from Japan's infamous "suicide forest" and enigmatic Knights Templar tunnels, to a top-secret wartime compound in Virginia; each holds clues to mysteries that have endured for generations.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: From a headless chicken that lives over one year, to an out-of-this-world "celestial body" where it rains molten glass, the team explores the most astonishing bodies through these truly unbelievable stories.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description: Some disguises hide an individual, others conceal an entire operation; a CIA vaccination campaign masks a global manhunt for the world's most wanted terrorist, while a luxury Red Sea resort operated by Mossad becomes the unlikely front for a mission to smuggle thousands of Sudanese Jews to safety; in wartime Philippines, an American singer uses charm, talent, and deception to outwit occupying forces and help rescue hundreds of POWs.

title: Forged in Fire
description: Four blade smiths turn snowflake canister Damascus into a deadly Yakut knife in freezing temperatures; after brutal testing, two competitors head home to tackle another Siberian staple.

title: The Food That Built America
description: Rival cereal giants race to invent the next must-have bowl, sparking a sugary arms race of mascots, crunch, candy and the first ever chocolate cereal.
